users: researchers developing sequence-regression models from declared experimental signals
not_intended_for: claiming heat-flux accuracy for a new sensor, condition, or data split without leakage-safe evaluation; or treating separately hosted weights and data as covered by the source license

required_inputs: compatible model weights when using pretrained models

limitations: GitHub releases and PyPI distributions are versioned independently.
Pretrained models, datasets, split definitions, and sensor alignment require study-specific verification.
